name: @github/copilot-engine-sdk
description: SDK for building engines on the GitHub Copilot agent platform

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle:mcp-server
scripts.bundle:mcp-server: esbuild src/mcp-server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/mcp-server.bundled.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module';const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
